name: Blush Pink Fluffy Heart Pillow Couch
prompt: Create a brand-new real editable Blender model of a cute plush pastel pink TWO-SEAT SOFA COUCH, not a chair and not a bed. Wide low upholstered sofa with one long cushy seat, thick rounded armrests on left and right, pillowy high backrest, soft fluffy faux-fur-like pink fabric appearance, softly rounded corners and little short hidden feet. Add four distinctive 3D HEART-SHAPED throw pillows: two cherry RED heart pillows and two snowy WHITE heart pillows across the backrest. Heart pillows should clearly look like hearts with two rounded top lobes and a pointed bottom, not circles or squares. Sweet romantic coquette / kawaii aesthetic, pastel bubblegum/blush pink fluffy tufted couch, plush cushion divisions and fabric softness, no metal or wood frame visible. Pink is dominant; red and white hearts are prominent. Make a complete recognizable sofa, front three-quarter rendered view showing the full two-seat width, plush upholstery and heart pillows. Keep the separate objects Blender-editable.
